entities.summary: Tanzimat, a notable figure in the history of Türkiye, associated with Tanzimat and Constitutional Era (1839–1908). Preceded by Gülhane Decree and Gülhane Decree launches the Tanzimat modernization program. Their legacy influenced Congress of Berlin — Ottoman Empire loses most of its European territories and Young Turk Revolution restores the Ottoman Constitution.
